data.name: Sharvamaan
data.gender_notes: Sharvamaan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Lord Shiva, the god of destruction
data.long_meaning: Sharvamaan is a name derived from the Hindu god Shiva, the god of destruction, transformation, and regeneration. This name signifies power, strength, and the ability to overcome obstacles and renew oneself. The name Sharvamaan carries the meaning “Lord Shiva, the god of destruction” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sharvamaan usually hope their child will grow to embody lord shiva, the god of destruction and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sharvamaan is a name that connects the bearer to the divine power of Lord Shiva, providing spiritual strength and guidance.
data.etymology: Sharvamaan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Shiva, the god of destruction.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sharvamaan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
